entry_points.text: Input controls fetch version identity repeat keymap name location properties and capabilities for keys axes force grab revoke mask clock.
Multiplexors attach tags notify probe confine share rings workers and polling; DMA benchmark, FAT helpers and filter commands included.
IOMMU command base spans destroy, address-space, table, info, dirty, invalidate, fault, virtual and queue allocation operations.
Key operations span identifiers linking search update and crypto; live-update spans session create retrieve preserve finish and naming.

exports.text: Event version guards user driver compatibility; io_uring opcodes form dense range with socket, cancel, query and filter extensions.
IO priority builder merges class level hint; filesystem identity, device numbers, mounts, memfd and NUMA contracts exported.
Netdev family manages devices pools queues NAPI and XSK with notifications and management and page-pool groups.

hazards.text: Timestamps vary with word size and padding; validate endian width packing flexible arrays shared counters sentinels pointers and alignment.
Priority packs class level hint bitfields; IP type and option bytes need mask extraction; version TTL offsets and ranges need bounds checks.
Enforce open group argument name path pipe extended-attribute and signal caps; check IPC octal modes and kexec flag placement and segment max.
Keyring selectors are negative; LSM identifiers and attributes use reserved bases; Landlock file network and scope rights are bit positions.
Match filesystem magics exactly without swapping endian pairs; device numbers repeat; mount and fsmount bits need mask-aware updates.
Check membarrier registration flow, memfd huge-page shift, policy mode order, DMA caps, queue depths, sector geometry and neighbour flags.
Re-query bonded clock index after failover; one tracking bit differs in kernel; mask reserved filter bits and respect name and data caps.

invariants.text: Distinct per-header include guards make repeated inclusion idempotent with no effect beyond preventing redefinition.
Counts derive as maxima plus one with aliases; attribute families run unspecified to public max one below internal bound.
Commands start with size then ids flags aligned pointers; reserves stay zero; restrictions allow opcodes with modifier sets.
Transmit timestamping orders disabled enabled then one-step; namespaces are one-based; status bits follow lifecycle with masks.

state_machines.text: Application advances submission tails and consumes completion heads; kernel mirrors with masks, wakeup, overflow and timed wait entry.
Objects allocate configure use and destroy; hardware queues move down to up on create and up to down on teardown; neighbours track reachability.
Sockets move free to unconnected to connecting to connected to disconnecting; tracking adds reply offset; generations bracket object changes.

structs.text: Device identity, absolute axis calibration, keymap entry; key ranges cover grip privacy directions media marine macros hats and force.
Force feedback chains replay trigger envelope with constant ramp condition periodic rumble and haptic variants under type id direction.
Submission and completion entries with ring offsets, creation parameters, protection attributes, timing and receive message metadata.
Single-bit selectors cover submission chaining, ring setup, fixed resources, per-operation modes and timestamp source placement.
Resource tables, buffer rings, BPF filters, mock probes, query chains and zero-copy areas carry counts tags offsets and statistics.
Address-space allocation, IOVA range query, mapping, file mapping, copy and unmap use size flags addresses lengths with read write bits.
Hardware page tables, virtual devices, event queues and hardware queues use flags vendor data, nesting handles and queue identifiers.
IPv4 and IPv6 headers with extension, routing, option and mobility structures; flexible trailing data sized from packet not sizeof.
IPC permissions, Diffie-Hellman and public-key parameters, Landlock ruleset and path or port constraints, LSM context and kexec segment.
Mount attributes and queries, DMA benchmark counters, UUIDs, module signature footers, MINIX inodes superblocks and directory entries.
Message queue and System V message descriptors, FAT boot geometry with directory slots, neighbour messages with cache and table stats.
Socket family multiplexing, timestamping options and configs, device naming and provenance, verdicts hooks and transport field overlays.
Packet-filter names registers and verdicts with table chain rule set element data expression and action attributes for match and update.
Netdev family version one with transmit actions, receive metadata, queue direction, statistics scope and threading mode.
